# Build big things with small models

A 4-week virtual hackathon. Build an application powered entirely by on-device AI models with 500 million parameters or fewer — no cloud APIs.

## Prize

### 🥇 Winner takes all

One project wins everything. Plus a certificate and gallery feature for all participants.

## Apply on-device AI meaningfully.

We’re looking for projects that show what’s possible with small, on-device AI. Solve a problem that actually exists—something where running AI locally makes the solution faster, cheaper, more private, more accessible, or simply possible—or use small models in a genuinely creative way we haven’t seen before. We want thoughtful applications, clever engineering, and ideas that feel authentic rather than AI bolted onto a project just for the sake of it. The model doesn’t have to be impressive. What you do with it does.

Every model you use must fit this cap. You can use multiple models

### No cloud AI API calls

Models run in your app. No OpenAI, Anthropic, or inference APIs. Non-AI APIs are fine.

### On your terms

Desktop, mobile, browser, edge device — anything goes.

### $1,000 Prize Pool

Winner takes all. Every participant gets a certificate and a spot in our gallery.

## Timeline

Virtual event — all times UTC.

Repos must be created after Sep 10, 2026 to qualify.

## Rules & acceptance criteria

Read these before you start — they determine whether you're accepted.

Every AI model you use must have ≤500M parameters. Multiple models are fine, as long as each is under the cap.

Models must run locally inside your app. No OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or inference APIs. Non-AI APIs are fine.
